items.subject: Ministry of Justice UK is hiring for a Remote role
items.summary: Automated recommendations include a Ministry of Justice Data Ethics and Literacy Hub Officer role and a Places for People Community Housing Manager role; the Greenwich vacancy was previously reported.
items.action: Review the Ministry of Justice Data Ethics and Literacy Hub Officer role first, then the Places for People Community Housing Manager role; check salary, requirements and closing dates and decide whether to apply.
items.decisionNeeded: Whether either newly listed role is worth applying for.
